# Synthetic EPUB translation chapter

Written for brofessor on 2026-11-04; distributed under the repository's MIT license.
All prose, CSS and the SVG are original synthetic test material. No real book,
user document, external font, model output or third-party illustration is included.

`mimetype`, `META-INF/` and `EPUB/` form an unpacked, reflowable EPUB 3 fixture.
The probe packs them into an EPUB under ignored `outputs/`. The chapter exercises
technical and ordinary senses of **log** and **head**, repeated terminology,
negation, numbers/units, inline emphasis, a table, a footnote/backlink, an image,
MathML and code that must remain unchanged.

This short chapter is a feasibility control, not whole-book translation acceptance.
